notes.title: New Update for better immersion
notes.content:
Hello, guys!

In order to bring you a better game experience, we are pleased to announce you our new update, which contains such new features:

A new type of ammunition - exploding bottles with AoE effect

Grab them from the box, aim and enjoy the explosion effects, while your opponents will be spectacularly turned into ashes. 

 Innovational gesticular spell casting system

Cherry on the cake of this update. Manage magic skills performing different figures in the air! 5 different spells are already available for your attention. New impressions and better immersion are guaranteed!  

Practice mode where you can learn game features and sharpen your skills

A new spell casting system will require some practice from you, but after trying it, you may not want to return to the basic controls. Practice mode suits the best for that purpose. 


We hope you enjoy our update. Write your opinions, impressions and what would you like to add

"MAD Cliff Dev Team"
2018.8.23
